title: 静默吞错改为故障可见：合并失败/次要源 I/O 错误/缓存解码异常/账号索引重置一律产出诊断或报错

target.component: 失败可见性: 采集与账号存储的静默降级路径
target.design_doc: docs/devel/design/01-数据采集与多模型计费引擎.md

why: 2026-10-16 全仓对抗性审查 (RV-005) 定位四处静默吞错, 后果按严重度排序: (1) application/lib.rs:729 finalize_local_agent 内 let _ = accumulator.merge_delta(&source.contribution) —— 合并失败被吞, agent.status 仍为 ok, 用量静默丢失; 同文件 aggregation.rs:48-56 对同类失败会产出 LOCAL_CONTRIBUTION_INVALID 诊断, 两处口径自相矛盾; (2) application/lib.rs:614-618 次要源 I/O 错误 (SourceScanError::Io) 直接返回空 SourceScan 且无任何诊断, jsonl_cache.rs:181-187 根非目录等场景用户完全不可见; (3) sources.rs:1695 let _ = builder.merge_contribution(&cached.aggregate) Codex 树缓存解码异常静默, 不计数不诊断; (4) apps/macos ProviderAccountStore.swift:260-261 try? decode ?? ProviderAccountIndex() 索引解码失败静默重置为空, 随后 saveIndex 覆盖导致 Keychain 遗留记录成孤儿, :288 loadRecord 同样 try? 解码为 nil 使账号无声消失, :352-356 removeAllAccounts 吞错。

precheck.description: 预检: 确认四处静默吞错位置在生产代码存在
precheck.command: grep -n 'let _ = accumulator.merge_delta' core/collector/crates/collector-application/src/lib.rs; grep -n 'SourceScanError::Io(_) => Ok((SourceScan::empty' core/collector/crates/collector-application/src/lib.rs; grep -n 'let _ = builder.merge_contribution' core/collector/crates/collector-local/src/sources.rs; grep -n 'try? decode' apps/macos/Sources/BruceOnboardingCore/ProviderAccountStore.swift
precheck.expected: 四处均命中; 且 aggregation.rs 存在对照的诊断化实现

before: # 无分支检出: 单人维护已在 main 实施

changes.before: let _ = accumulator.merge_delta(&source.contribution) 吞掉失败, agent 仍 ok
changes.after: 合并失败 -> 产出 LOCAL_CONTRIBUTION_INVALID 诊断并把 agent 置为 partial (与 aggregation.rs 口径统一)
changes.impact: 用量丢失不再静默; 与同仓既有诊断语义一致

changes.scope: collector-application: 次要源 I/O 可见
changes.before: SourceScanError::Io 直接产出空 SourceScan 且无诊断
changes.after: 产出 LOCAL_SOURCE_IO_DEGRADED 信息级诊断 (note 说明), 区分「源不存在」与「读取失败」
changes.impact: I/O 降级可观测, 不误报为故障

changes.scope: collector-local: 树缓存解码异常可见
changes.after: 失败计入 cache_corruptions 并附诊断
changes.impact: 缓存损坏可统计可诊断

changes.scope: mac 账号索引: 解码失败不再静默重置
changes.before: try? decode ?? ProviderAccountIndex() / try? 解码 nil / try? deleteRecord
changes.after: 索引解码失败抛出并附恢复建议; loadRecord 失败区分「不存在」与「损坏」; removeAllAccounts 失败向调用方传播
changes.impact: 账号列表不再被空索引覆盖, 删除失败不再假成功

design.doc: docs/devel/design/01-数据采集与多模型计费引擎.md

rule_diff.before: design/01 有 fail-visible 精神但未把「降级必须伴诊断」写成强制规则; design/02 未约定账号索引损坏语义
rule_diff.after: 新增规则: 采集链路任何降级 (合并失败/I/O 失败/缓存损坏) 必须产出诊断或标记 partial; 账号索引解码失败必须报错而非重置为空索引
